## Advisor angle
A stock slump plus a likely rate hike would push clients to ask whether to sell. An advisor would stress the plan, time horizon, and diversification, and would explain how higher rates affect both bond prices and borrowing costs.

## Term of the day: Correction
A correction is a drop of 10% or more from a recent peak. CNBC's live blog says the S&P 500 and Dow entered one ([CNBC](https://news.google.?oc=5)). Corrections are common and are not the same as a bear market, which is a 20% or larger fall.

## Interview talking point
"This week showed that stocks and rate expectations can move together: an AI-led sell-off hit just as the Fed minutes pointed toward a December hike, so I'd focus on helping clients stick to their plan."
